profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Fastly
profile.summary: Experienced software developer with an interest in infrastructure. Skilled at designing and developing highly available solutions, as well as automation of infrastructure processes in both on-premise and cloud environments. Passionate about open source and keeping up with the latest technology.

positions.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on a small team of SREs developing and supporting our SkySQL SaaS offering. My day to day work involved heavy use of Go, Python, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Bash in order to develop new features of SkySQL and maintain our production landscape. I have also played a large part in designing logging, monitoring, and security solutions for our fleet of deployments. A good portion of my work involved optimizing open source software for use in production and writing code for use cases that cannot be supported by existing open source software.

Notable Projects:

- Developed scalable microservice-oriented database health checking solution in Golang
- Researched and developed critical VPC peering feature for our database offering
- Designed and built Elasticsearch logging solution on Kubernetes for aggregating logs from hundreds of Kubernetes clusters with auditing, full Xpack Security configuration, and OIDC integration using Google + Dex
- With two other SREs, designed and deployed highly available and scalable monitoring solution for all of our Kubernetes clusters using Prometheus, AlertManager, and ServiceNow. Contributed PRs back to AlertManager and ServiceNow integration project involved in the complete solution.
- Helped architect database credential generation system using Vault with OIDC integration for troubleshooting customer issues
- Regularly involved in automation and new features for our current GCP offering and participating in our multi-cloud solution
positions.insights: Git, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and +9 skills

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
- Deployed and maintained multiple Kubernetes clusters (vanilla, OpenShift, GKE On-Prem) and transitioned developers and data scientists to container technologies. 
- Maintained Ansible Tower and AWX deployments and served as point person for onboarding teams to automation of infrastructure and application deployments with Ansible.
- Automated and maintained enterprise infrastructure with a DevOps mindset, including Linux server, storage / SAN, virtualization, and containerization platforms.
- Served in an on-call rotation and troubleshooted production outages.

positions.title: SAP ABAP Developer
positions.description: I developed extensively within the Product Lifecycle Management module of our SAP ERP system to optimize and customize business-critical programs. I also adapted many existing custom programs to an object oriented design pattern.

positions.title: Computer Engineering TA
positions.description: Served as a TA for two introductory C programming courses and a social mentor to Iowa State freshmen in the learning community.

positions.title: Mobile Development Intern
positions.description: Developed a hybrid mobile application for searching and browsing Microsoft SharePoint using the ASP.NET MVC 3 Framework, SharePoint FAST Search Server 2010, and PhoneGap.
